annotations.title: List or create leases in the account

description: WHEN you need the subscriber's leases. Lists them (lot, tenant, rent, status); with `creer` {lot_id, tenant_id, start_date (YYYY-MM-DD), rent, charges?, deposit?, payment_day?, lease_type? (habitation_vide, habitation_meublee, commercial…), duration_months?} creates an active lease and marks the lot rented. Refused if the lot already has an active lease.
